title: North Dragon Island's envoy
summary: Xiao Yan comes out of Demonic Saint Huang Quan's stone tablet unhurt, then catches an envoy from North Dragon Island at the pythons' border. The envoy admits that the North, West and South Dragon Islands have joined against East Dragon Island, where a new Dragon Emperor has risen. The Northern Dragon King sent him with Ancient Celestial Serpent essence blood to win over the pythons, and the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe has been asked to join too. Xiao Yan shares Huang Quan's essence blood with everyone and keeps a drop for Yao Lao. He tells Yao Ming the new Dragon Emperor is Zi Yan and asks him to stay out of the war, but Yao Ming offers to fight beside him. They plan to ambush the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe. Medusa stays to cultivate in the Nine Serene Spring, and Xiao Yan gives her a ninth-tier pill before he leaves.
events: Xiao Yan leaves the stone tablet with Huang Quan's inheritance.
He senses Void Ancient Dragons and wonders whether Zi Yan is in trouble.
He captures an envoy from North Dragon Island and makes him talk.
The envoy reveals the three Dragon Islands' war on East Dragon Island and the phoenix alliance.
Yao Ming reorganises the tribe and recalls the Rock Scale and Green Leaf Python tribes.
Xiao Yan shares the essence blood and learns Yao Ming had been offered a dragon alliance.
Yao Ming agrees to help Xiao Yan stop the Heaven Demon Phoenix Tribe.
Medusa starts cultivating in the spring; Xiao Yan gives her the Bodhi Great Elixir.
cultivation: Yao Ming says he is now 'at the late stage of a two-star Dou Sheng' and expects to reach Three-Star within three years. Xiao Yan says the drop he keeps for Yao Lao should raise him to One-Star Dou Sheng.
